title: AI used to reply. Now it acts first. Claude Duet is the start.
subtitle: Claude Duet checks your apps, briefs you each morning and drafts the work before you ask, then waits for your yes. If you already live in Claude, here is what changes, and what it costs.
youtube_title: AI used to reply. Now it acts first. Claude Duet is the start.
youtube_description:
Claude Duet is Anthropic's new Claude app, and it messages you first. Every few hours it checks your email, your calendar and the apps you've connected, sends you a morning brief and drafts the work. Before it sends, pays, signs or deletes anything, it waits for your yes.

If you already live in Claude, the big change is who starts the work: it turns up first, and your job becomes saying yes or no. We asked it for a calendar scheduler and got a dashboard we can share. You ask once, and you get a tool.

The catch: it reads one email account, it's slow, and its background checks count toward your Claude plan's limit.

The full deep dive is at makeyourmindup.ai

linkedin_post:
AI used to wait to be asked. Claude Duet doesn't. It checks your email and calendar every few hours, briefs you each morning, drafts the work, then waits for your yes before it sends, pays, signs or deletes.

If you already work in Claude, your job moves from asking to approving. That only sticks if you hand it one weekly job whose inputs already live in the apps it can reach.

And if you run IT: decide now whether staff may connect work email to a personal Claude plan, before they ask.

The full deep dive is at makeyourmindup.ai.
